source.data_origin: PZT (piezoelectric) secondary actuator in dual-stage HDD positioning system. Modal-sum decomposition.
source.ingestion_notes: Modal parameters lifted directly from plant.py via WebFetch on 2026-05-12. Source values in Hz; converted to rad/s by 2π factor as in the source code.

substrate_class_variant: PZT secondary actuator in dual-stage HDD positioning system. Strictly piezoelectric, not voice-coil — same substrate-class via second-order mechanical oscillator structure but different drive mechanism.
substrate_class_notes: PZT actuators are technically a different drive-coupling than voice coil (electrostrictive vs Lorentz), but the substrate's mechanical response is the same second-order damped oscillator. Reading PZT under the voice-coil-actuator substrate-class tests whether the substrate-class scope captures both drive mechanisms or whether PZT earns its own class. Substrate-class scope decision deferred to Phase A discussion.

regime_summary.notes: Mode 7 (ζ=0.3, Q=1.667) is much closer to s-boundary than the rest. Still c-regime (Q > 0.5) but the broadband-damped mode of the structure — likely a designed-in roll-off rather than a structural resonance peak.
